_readme: Fares per dataset id (same ids as cities.json). A dataset with no entry shows 'no info' in the app. ride = single-ride price; cap = max total per day; metroOneTicket = changing between metro lines needs no new ticket. Only add numbers you can link a source for.

sofia.note: Single ticket since 1 Jan 2026. Daily cap applies from the 3rd trip of a day.

sources.t: Sofia University - daily cap EUR 2 after 3 trips
Sofia Metro - one metro ticket, unlimited metro changes

plovdiv.note: City bus single ticket, EUR 0.50 since 1 Feb 2026 as reported by media.

sources.t: BNT - current city ticket price EUR 0.50

burgas.note: Reported at the start of 2026 (disputed increase) - may have changed since.

sources.t: Novinite - Burgas single ticket 80 euro cents
